title: VAT Returns list loads and displays all columns for an authorised user
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has VAT.VIEW). At least one VAT return exists for the company. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
steps:
1. Log in as ORG_ADMIN.
2. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
3. Observe the company selector auto-selects the first company and the table loads.
4. Read each row: return number, period (YYYY-MM), status badge, money columns.
testData: Company: Acme Trading Ltd. At least one DRAFT and one FILED return seeded.
expected: Table renders with correct columns. Status badge shows DRAFT in warning colour and FILED in success colour. Money amounts formatted to 2 decimal places. Clicking a row navigates to /admin/tax/vat-returns/uid/:uid. No raw UID visible as table cell text.

title: VAT Returns list shows empty state when company has no returns
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A second company exists with no VAT returns.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
2. Use the company selector to switch to the company with no returns.
3. Observe the table area.
expected: A distinct empty-state message is shown (not a spinner and not an error). No rows appear. Switching back to the populated company reloads the table with rows.

title: VAT Returns list forbidden for user without VAT.VIEW permission
preconditions: A user exists with NO permissions assigned. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns as that user.
steps:
1. Log in as a user with no permissions.
2. Inspect the sidebar — confirm the Tax > VAT Returns nav item is not shown.
3. Attempt to navigate directly to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
expected: The VAT Returns nav item is hidden. Direct navigation is blocked by the requirePermission guard and the user sees a forbidden/redirect state. The API GET /api/v1/vat/returns returns 403.

title: Open a new DRAFT VAT return for a company with no prior return (opening credit = 0)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has VAT.RETURN.PREPARE). No existing return for the selected company and period. Company has no prior FILED return.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
2. Click New VAT Return.
3. Enter Year = 2026, select Month = March.
4. Submit.
testData: Year: 2026, Month: 3 (March). Company: Acme Trading Ltd.
expected: HTTP 201. New DRAFT return created with returnNumber, periodStart 2026-03-01, periodEnd 2026-03-31, dueDate 2026-04-20, openingCredit = 0.00. UI navigates to the detail screen showing a success toast with the return number. No raw UID appears as visible text.

title: Opening credit carries forward from prior FILED return
preconditions: A prior return for period 2026-02 is FILED with closingCredit = 50000.00. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open a new VAT return for period 2026-03.
2. Navigate to the detail of the new return.
3. Read the Opening Credit b/f field.
expected: New return shows openingCredit = 50000.00 and priorReturnId points to the FILED Feb return. Net VAT reflects the subtraction of the opening credit. Only a FILED prior return is used — a DRAFT prior return does not contribute.

title: Duplicate period rejected with 409 (BR-VAT-01)
preconditions: A VAT return already exists for the company and period 2026-03. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
2. Click New VAT Return.
3. Enter Year 2026, Month March.
4. Submit.
testData: Year: 2026, Month: 3. A return for this period already exists.
expected: 409 ConflictException. The UI shows an inline error from errors[0]: 'A VAT return already exists for company ... period 2026-03 (BR-VAT-01).' No second return is created. Same month for a different company would succeed.

title: VAT Return detail renders bands, summary, and net Payable label (output > input)
preconditions: A DRAFT return exists for the company with outputVat = 180000.00, inputVat = 80000.00, adjustments = 0, openingCredit = 0. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/vat-returns.
2. Click the DRAFT return row.
3. Read the Return Face card: band table, total output, total input, net row, net label.
expected: Band table shows at least one STANDARD row with taxable base and output VAT. Net = 180000 - 80000 = 100000.00. Net label reads 'Payable to TRA' with danger styling. Money formatted to 2 dp. No raw UID visible on screen.

title: VAT Return detail shows Credit carried forward label when input > output
preconditions: A DRAFT return exists with outputVat = 40000.00, inputVat = 90000.00. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Read the net row and the closing credit row.
expected: Net = -50000.00. Net label reads 'Credit carried forward' with success styling. A Closing Credit c/f row shows 50000.00. This closing credit becomes the next period's openingCredit only after this return is FILED.

title: Recompute a DRAFT VAT return updates bands and net
preconditions: A DRAFT return exists. New sales/purchase activity has been recorded since the last compute. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has VAT.RETURN.PREPARE).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Note the current outputVat and net figures.
3. Click Recompute.
4. Observe the updated figures.
testData: Any DRAFT return with additional transactions recorded after last compute.
expected: Bands deleted and re-inserted; totals refreshed; net and closingCredit recomputed. A success toast is shown. Updated figures display in place. The Recompute button is visible because the user holds VAT.RETURN.PREPARE.

title: Recompute blocked on a FILED return (BR-VAT-02)
preconditions: A FILED return exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open a FILED return detail.
2. Confirm the Recompute button is not rendered (isDraft() is false).
3. Attempt POST /api/v1/vat/returns/uid/{uid}/recompute directly via API on the FILED return UID.
expected: UI never shows the Recompute control on a FILED return. API call returns an error: 'Cannot recompute a FILED VAT return (BR-VAT-02).' No status change occurs.

title: File a DRAFT return with net payable — GL settlement journal is posted
preconditions: A DRAFT return with outputVat = 180000.00 and inputVat = 80000.00. GL config has VAT_PAYABLE, VAT_INPUT, VAT_DUE mapped. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has VAT.RETURN.FILE).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Click File Return.
3. Enter Filing Reference: TRA/VAT/2026/001234.
4. Enter Filing Date: 2026-04-15.
5. Click Confirm File.
expected: Final recompute runs and figures freeze. Status changes to FILED. filingReference, filingDate, filedAt, filedBy are recorded. A balanced settlement journal is posted: DR VAT_PAYABLE 180000, CR VAT_INPUT 80000, CR VAT_DUE 100000. postedJournalUid is set and shown as a link to /admin/gl/journals/uid/:uid. All DRAFT actions (Recompute, File, Add Adjustment) disappear. Success toast shown.

title: Filing blocked while prior-period return is still DRAFT (D-4 ordering gate)
preconditions: Period 2026-02 is DRAFT. Period 2026-03 is also DRAFT. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the 2026-03 DRAFT return detail.
2. Click File Return.
3. Attempt to confirm filing.
expected: Filing 2026-03 is rejected: 'Prior period return <number> must be FILED before this period can be filed (D-4).' Error surface in the File form. After filing 2026-02 first, filing 2026-03 succeeds. If no prior return exists the gate does not apply.

title: Re-filing an already-FILED return rejected (BR-VAT-11)
preconditions: A FILED return exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open a FILED return.
2. Confirm the File Return control is not shown.
3. Attempt POST /api/v1/vat/returns/uid/{uid}/file directly via API.
expected: UI shows no File Return control on a FILED return. API returns: 'VAT return already FILED (BR-VAT-11).' No state change. Return remains FILED.

title: Nil-activity return (output = input = 0) files without posting a GL journal
preconditions: A period with no sales or purchases so both outputVat = 0 and inputVat = 0. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the nil-activity DRAFT return.
2. Confirm net label is Nil and no closing credit row.
3. File the return with a filing reference and date.
expected: Return files to FILED status. postedJournalUid is null (no GL journal per D-8). The posted journal link is absent on the detail screen. Status badge shows FILED.

title: Add an INCREASE adjustment to a DRAFT return and see net increase
preconditions: A DRAFT return with known net (e.g. 100000.00). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has VAT.ADJUST).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Click Add Adjustment.
3. Select Reason: Prior Period Correction.
4. Select Effect: Increase VAT.
5. Enter Amount: 5000.
6. Enter Narrative: Q1 under-declaration.
7. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Adjustment row appears showing reason label, INCREASE badge (danger), amount 5000.00, and narrative. adjustmentsTotal increases by 5000 and net becomes 105000.00. The effect dropdown offers exactly INCREASE and DECREASE options.

title: Add a DECREASE adjustment (Bad Debt Relief) and see net decrease
preconditions: A DRAFT return with net 100000.00. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Click Add Adjustment.
3. Reason: Bad Debt Relief, Effect: Decrease VAT, Amount: 8000.
4. Submit.
expected: DECREASE badge shown in success colour. adjustmentsTotal decreases by 8000 (signed -8000). Net = 92000.00. Reason dropdown offers exactly five options: Bad Debt Relief, Prior Period Correction, Credit Note VAT, Debit Note VAT, Other.

title: Adjustment amount must be positive — zero and negative rejected
preconditions: A DRAFT return. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open Add Adjustment.
2. Enter Amount = 0, submit.
3. Enter Amount = -10, submit.
4. Bypass client and POST directly with amount -10.
expected: Client blocks: 'Enter a positive amount.' Server @Positive BigDecimal amount returns 400 with envelope errors if bypassed. Sign is carried via VatAdjustmentSign enum so the magnitude is always positive.

title: Remove an adjustment from a DRAFT return reverts the net
preconditions: A DRAFT return with one INCREASE adjustment of 5000.00. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT return detail.
2. Click the Remove (trash) button on the adjustment row.
3. Observe the updated net.
expected: HTTP 204. The row disappears. adjustmentsTotal reverts (drops by 5000). Net recomputed without the adjustment. Remove button has aria-label 'Remove adjustment <reason>'.

title: Add/remove adjustment blocked on a FILED return (BR-VAT-09)
preconditions: A FILED return with an existing adjustment. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the FILED return.
2. Confirm no Add Adjustment or Remove controls are shown.
3. Attempt POST /api/v1/vat/returns/uid/{returnUid}/adjustments via API.
4. Attempt DELETE .../adjustments/uid/{uid} via API.
testData: A FILED VAT return with one adjustment.
expected: UI shows no Add/Remove controls on a FILED return. POST returns: 'Cannot add adjustment to a FILED VAT return (BR-VAT-09).' DELETE returns: 'Cannot remove adjustment from a FILED VAT return (BR-VAT-09).' Reading adjustments (GET) still works with VAT.VIEW.

title: WHT Types list loads with code, name, kind badge, rate, and active flag
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has WHT.VIEW). At least one WHT type exists for the company.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/wht-types.
2. Observe loading then the table.
testData: At least one WHT type with kind WHT_ON_PAYMENT.
expected: Table lists each type with code, name, kind badge ('On Payment' or 'On Receipt'), rate as percentage to 2 dp, and active flag. No raw UID in any cell. Nav item visible for WHT.VIEW holders; hidden for users without this permission.

title: Create WHT type (WHT_ON_PAYMENT kind) — happy path
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has WHT.MANAGE). Code WHT-SERV not already used for this company.
steps:
1. On /admin/tax/wht-types, click New WHT Type.
2. Enter Code: WHT-SERV, Name: Service fees (resident), Kind: On Payment, Rate: 5.
3. Submit.
testData: code: WHT-SERV, name: Service fees (resident), kind: WHT_ON_PAYMENT, ratePct: 5.
expected: HTTP 201. Row added to the list showing the code, name, kind badge 'On Payment', rate 5.00%. Success toast shown. Kind is fixed at create and cannot be changed by update.

title: Create WHT type — duplicate code rejected (409) per company
preconditions: Code WHT-SERV already exists for this company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Click New WHT Type.
2. Enter Code: WHT-SERV, Name: Another service, Kind: On Payment, Rate: 3.
3. Submit.
expected: 409 ConflictException: 'WHT type code WHT-SERV already exists for this company.' Inline form error displayed. Same code in a different company would succeed (uniqueness is per company).

title: WHT type rate entered as a percentage — zero is valid, negative is rejected
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open New WHT Type form.
2. Enter Rate = -1, submit.
3. Then enter Rate = 0, submit.
expected: Rate -1: client blocks 'Enter a valid rate (0 or greater).' Server @Min(0) ratePct rejects if bypassed. Rate 0 is accepted (a zero-rate WHT type is valid). Rate field represents a percentage value — e.g., entering 5 means 5%.

title: Edit WHT type name, rate, and active — code and kind remain immutable
preconditions: An existing WHT type WHT-SERV. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has WHT.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Click edit on the WHT-SERV row.
2. Change Name to: Service fees (revised).
3. Change Rate to: 7.5.
4. Toggle Active to true.
5. Save.
testData: name: Service fees (revised), ratePct: 7.5, active: true.
expected: Row updates in place. Success toast. Code and kind are not editable (UpdateWhtTypeRequest has no code or kind field). Validation: blank name or negative rate rejected.

title: Deactivate a WHT type (soft deactivation — row remains visible)
preconditions: An ACTIVE WHT type exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has WHT.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Click Deactivate on an active WHT type row.
2. Observe the row after deactivation.
expected: active flips to false. The row remains in the table (no hard delete) with the inactive indicator. The Deactivate control is suppressed on the now-inactive row. Re-deactivating is a no-op (idempotent). Reactivation is possible via Edit (set active = true).

title: WHT Types read-only for a user with WHT.VIEW but not WHT.MANAGE
preconditions: A CUSTOM role with only WHT.VIEW assigned. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Open /admin/tax/wht-types.
2. Observe available controls.
3. Attempt POST /api/v1/wht/types directly.
expected: Table visible and reads correctly. No New WHT Type, Edit, or Deactivate controls (canManage is false). Direct POST returns 403. GET list and GET by UID succeed.

title: WHT Register loads by year and month, splits by kind with group totals
preconditions: WHT transactions exist for March 2026 in both WHT_ON_PAYMENT (from AP payment) and WHT_ON_RECEIPT (from AR receipt). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has WHT.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/wht-register.
2. Select company.
3. Choose period mode Month, Year 2026, Month March.
4. Click Load.
testData: year: 2026, month: 3 (March). WHT transactions seeded via AP and AR flows.
expected: Two sections appear: 'WHT Payable to TRA' (WHT_ON_PAYMENT rows) and 'WHT Receivable' (WHT_ON_RECEIPT rows). Each row shows whtNumber, party name, source ref, taxable base, WHT amount, certificate date. Each section shows a group total (totalPayable / totalReceivable). Money formatted to 2 dp. Dates ISO format.

title: WHT Register loads by explicit date range (periodStart / periodEnd)
preconditions: WHT transactions exist in Q1 2026. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/tax/wht-register.
2. Switch period mode to Range.
3. Set periodStart 2026-01-01, periodEnd 2026-03-31.
4. Click Load.
expected: Register covers the inclusive date range. Rows filtered on certificateDate BETWEEN start AND end. If year+month are also provided alongside the range, year+month takes precedence.

title: WHT Register requires a valid period — error when neither complete pair is supplied
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Switch to Range mode.
2. Provide only periodStart, leave periodEnd blank.
3. Click Load.
expected: Server raises IllegalArgumentException: 'Provide either year+month or periodStart+periodEnd.' Error state rendered; no results shown. Providing only year without month is similarly insufficient.

title: Currency list shows seeded active currencies — inactive excluded
preconditions: V77 seed applied: TZS, USD, EUR, KES, GBP active. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has CURRENCY.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/rates.
2. Open the from-currency picker and read available options.
testData: Seeded currencies: TZS, USD, EUR, KES, GBP.
expected: Picker lists exactly TZS, USD, EUR, KES, GBP. Currencies shown by code/name not UID. An INACTIVE currency (e.g. GBP set inactive) is excluded. API GET /api/v1/fx/currencies returns ApiResponse<CurrencyDto[]> with active=true records only.

title: Add a new SPOT rate USD to TZS — happy path
preconditions: Company base currency = TZS. USD and TZS are active. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has CURRENCY.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Go to /admin/fx/rates.
2. Select company by name.
3. Click New rate.
4. Choose from = USD (from picker by code), to = TZS (from picker by code).
5. Enter rate: 2500.00000000, effective date: 2026-01-01, rateType: SPOT, source: manual.
6. Submit.
testData: fromCurrency: USD, toCurrency: TZS, rate: 2500, effectiveDate: 2026-01-01, rateType: SPOT.
expected: Success toast: 'Rate added — USD/TZS @ 2500.' New row appears at the top of the newest-first list. Rate stored with scale 8. No edit control on existing rows (append-only). HTTP 200 with envelope. Rate displayed to 6 dp by fmtRate.

title: Rate rejected when to_currency is not the company base (v1 rule)
preconditions: Company base = TZS. USD and EUR both active. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Click New rate.
2. Choose from = EUR, to = USD (neither is base TZS).
3. Submit.
testData: fromCurrency: EUR, toCurrency: USD, rate: 1.1, effectiveDate: 2026-01-01.
expected: Rejected: 'to_currency USD must equal company base currency TZS in v1.' HTTP 400. No row created. Setting to = TZS (the base) would succeed.

title: Rate rejected for unknown or inactive currency code
preconditions: GBP set inactive. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Add rate from = ZZZ (unknown) to TZS.
2. Add rate from = GBP (inactive) to TZS.
expected: ZZZ rejected: 'Unknown from-currency: ZZZ.' GBP rejected: 'Currency is not active: GBP.' Both HTTP 400. No rows created.

title: Rate validation — rate must be positive, codes must be 3 characters, from != to
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Enter from = US (2 chars) — expect client error.
2. Enter from = USD, to = USD (equal) — expect client error.
3. Enter rate = 0 — expect client error.
4. Bypass client and POST rate = -5.
expected: Client errors: 'From-currency must be a 3-letter ISO code.' / 'From and To currencies must differ.' / 'Rate must be a positive number.' Server: @Positive + @Size(min=3,max=3) + service double-check reject. Rate 0.00000001 (scale 8) is accepted.

title: Correction rate is a new row — duplicate composite key rejected
preconditions: USD to TZS SPOT rate exists for 2026-01-01. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Add USD to TZS SPOT at rate 2550, effective 2026-02-01 — succeeds (new row).
2. Confirm no edit control on the 2026-01-01 row.
3. Attempt to add USD to TZS SPOT at rate 2600, effective 2026-01-01 again.
testData: Existing row: USD/TZS SPOT 2026-01-01. New attempt: same composite key.
expected: Step 1 succeeds (different date). Step 3 violates uq_currency_rate unique constraint and surfaces a 4xx error. No in-place mutation ever occurs (columns are updatable=false). Same date with different rateType (e.g. CLOSING) is allowed.

title: Rate list is paginated newest-first and shows four states
preconditions: More than 50 rate rows for the company. A company with zero rates. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/rates with the multi-rate company.
2. Exercise paginator FIRST, PREVIOUS, page numbers, NEXT, LAST.
3. Switch to the zero-rate company.
4. Force a server error and observe.
5. Log in as a user with no permissions and navigate to the route.
testData: 51+ rate rows. Zero-rate company. No-permission user.
expected: Rows ordered by effectiveDate DESC. Paginator FIRST/PREV/numbers/NEXT/LAST present. Zero-rate company shows distinct empty state. Server error shows error state. 403 maps to forbidden state (not generic error). Paginator self-hides with 1 or fewer pages.

title: View-only user cannot write rates — button hidden and API 403
preconditions: CUSTOM role with only CURRENCY.VIEW. User assigned to this role.
steps:
1. Log in as the view-only user.
2. Navigate to /admin/fx/rates.
3. Confirm the New rate button is not shown.
4. Attempt POST /api/v1/fx/rates directly.
expected: Rate list loads successfully (read allowed). New rate button is hidden (canManage is false). Direct POST returns 403. A user with neither CURRENCY.VIEW nor CURRENCY.MANAGE sees the list return 403 -> forbidden state.

title: Preview FX revaluation — AR gain run (dry run, no GL posted)
preconditions: Open foreign AR invoice USD 100 carrying TZS 250000. USD to TZS SPOT rate 2600 effective on period end. An OPEN FiscalPeriod exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has FX.REVALUE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/revaluation-runs.
2. Select company by name.
3. Click Preview.
4. Choose the fiscal period via the period picker (by period label).
5. Leave spot-rate-date blank (defaults to period end).
6. Run preview.
expected: Preview shows AR/USD line: outstandingTxn 100, carryingBase 250000, spotRate 2600, revaluedBase 260000, adjustment +10000. Header totalGain = 10000, totalLoss = 0, netAdjustment = +10000. No run row is created. The run list is unchanged.

title: Preview FX revaluation — AR loss run (spot < invoice rate)
preconditions: Open foreign AR invoice USD 100 carrying TZS 250000. USD to TZS SPOT rate 2400. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Preview revaluation for the period with spot rate 2400.
expected: AR/USD line adjustment = -10000. Header totalGain = 0, totalLoss = 10000, netAdjustment = -10000. Loss styled distinctly (deltaClass danger). No run row persisted.

title: Post revaluation run creates balanced GL journal and auto-reverses when next period is open
preconditions: Open foreign AR and AP exposure. GL config UNREALIZED_FX_GAIN, UNREALIZED_FX_LOSS, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE, ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE set. Current period and next period both OPEN. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Preview the period (from FX-009 scenario).
2. Enter posting date = period end.
3. Click Post.
testData: posting date = fiscal period end, net adjustment != 0.
expected: HTTP 201 CREATED. Run row with runNumber (FXR-NNNNN). Because the next period is open, auto-reversal fires immediately: final status = REVERSED with both glEntryUid and reversalGlEntryUid populated. GL journal is balanced (Sigma debit == Sigma credit). Success toast with run number. List refreshes.

title: Posting same period twice is idempotent — no duplicate run or GL
preconditions: A run already posted for the period. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Post the run for period P (succeeds, first time).
2. Attempt to post again for the same period P.
expected: Second post is a true idempotent no-op — returns the existing run DTO (status POSTED or REVERSED), does NOT create a second run or second GL entry. Backed by uq_fx_revaluation_run_company_period unique constraint and service existing-run short-circuit.

title: Posting deferred reversal — status remains POSTED when next period is not yet open
preconditions: Open foreign exposure. Next fiscal period is NOT open. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Post the revaluation run for the current period.
testData: Next period closed or not created.
expected: HTTP 201. Status = POSTED, glEntryUid set, reversalGlEntryUid = null (reversal deferred). The run row shows a Reverse affordance. The outer transaction committed successfully (no poison from the deferred reversal attempt).

title: Explicit reverse of a POSTED run when next period is now open
preconditions: A run in POSTED status with reversalGlEntryUid = null. Next period now OPEN. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. In the run list, expand the POSTED run.
2. Click Reverse.
3. Enter reversal date: 2026-04-01.
4. Confirm.
expected: Reversal journal posted. Status -> REVERSED, reversalGlEntryUid set. List row updates in place. Success toast. Reversal is a new GL entry, never an edit.

title: Illegal lifecycle transitions for revaluation run — reverse before post and re-reverse
preconditions: Runs in PREVIEWED and REVERSED states. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Attempt to reverse a PREVIEWED run.
2. Attempt to reverse an already-REVERSED run.
3. Attempt to reverse a POSTED run with glEntryUid = null.
testData: Runs in PREVIEWED, REVERSED, and POSTED (no GL) states.
expected: Reverse PREVIEWED: 'Run has not been posted yet.' Reverse REVERSED: idempotent no-op, returns run unchanged. Reverse POSTED with no GL entry: 'has no GL entry to reverse.' No duplicate reversal posted.

title: Revaluation run list paginates, shows four states, scoped to company
preconditions: More than 20 runs for the company. A zero-run company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has FX.EXPOSURE.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/revaluation-runs.
2. Exercise paginator.
3. Switch to the zero-run company.
4. Force a 5xx.
5. Log in as user without FX.EXPOSURE.VIEW.
expected: Paginated list with meta. Empty state for zero-run company. Error state on 5xx. Forbidden state (not error) on 403. Paginator self-hides at 1 page. Run UIDs not shown — runNumber is the human identifier.

title: FX.EXPOSURE.VIEW-only role cannot trigger preview or post (RBAC split)
preconditions: CUSTOM role with only FX.EXPOSURE.VIEW. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fx/revaluation-runs.
2. Confirm Preview and Post actions are not shown (canRevalue is false).
3. Call GET /api/v1/fx/revaluation-runs/preview directly — expect 403.
4. Call POST /api/v1/fx/revaluation-runs directly — expect 403.
expected: List and read (GET) succeed. Preview/Post/Reverse actions hidden in UI. API calls to preview and post return 403. FX.REVALUE is required for those actions.

title: Status badges and gain/loss colours reflect run state correctly
preconditions: Runs in POSTED and REVERSED states. A gain run and a loss run present. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open /admin/fx/revaluation-runs.
2. Observe status badges: POSTED -> success, REVERSED -> secondary.
3. Observe net adjustment colour: positive -> success, negative -> danger.
testData: Mix of POSTED/REVERSED runs with positive and negative adjustments.
expected: Badge colours match documented statusBadgeClass. Amount colours match netAdjClass. Amounts formatted to 2 dp. Net 0 shows muted colour. Colour is NOT the only signal — text labels also present.

title: Multi-tenant isolation — company A cannot see or post company B FX data
preconditions: Two companies A and B. USD rate and a posted run exist in each. User assigned only to company A. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. List rates with companyId = A -> only A's data shown.
2. Attempt to POST a rate with companyId = B.

testData: Company A user, company B IDs.

title: Income Statement renders sections, subtotals, and reconciled bar
preconditions: Company with posted journals across INCOME and EXPENSE accounts for Q1 2026. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.PL.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/income-statement.
2. Choose company by name.
3. Set Period from: 2026-01-01, Period to: 2026-03-31.
4. Leave comparative blank.
5. Click Run.
testData: from: 2026-01-01, to: 2026-03-31. Company: Acme Trading Ltd.
expected: Table shows sections REVENUE, COST_OF_SALES, OPERATING_EXPENSES with detail lines, per-section subtotals, and tfoot rows Gross Profit and Net Profit. Green Reconciled alert (role=status) shown when books tie. Money to 2 dp. Negative net profit in danger styling. No UID in any cell.

title: Income Statement comparative period populates fourth column
preconditions: Postings in both Q1 and Q2 2026. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/income-statement.
2. Set from/to = Q2 2026.
3. Set Comparative from/to = Q1 2026.
4. Click Run.
expected: Comparative column header shows the prior period label. All detail lines carry both current and comparative amounts. Gross Profit and Net Profit tfoot rows carry both. cmpFrom/cmpTo params sent only when both are provided.

title: Income Statement account line drill-through navigates to account ledger pre-filled
preconditions: Income statement with at least one real detail line (accountUid non-null). Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.PL.VIEW and REPORT.LEDGER.VIEW).
steps:
1. Run the income statement.
2. Click the account name link in a revenue detail row (e.g. Sales Revenue).
expected: Navigation to /admin/reporting/account-ledger?accountUid=<uid>&fromDate=<from>&toDate=<to>&companyId=<id>. Ledger auto-runs. The link label is the human account name. No raw UID shown as text. A synthetic equity-fold line with null accountUid renders as plain text, not a link.

title: Income Statement export to PDF, XLSX, CSV gated by REPORT.EXPORT
preconditions: Income statement run complete. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.EXPORT). Also test as a role without REPORT.EXPORT.
steps:
1. Run the statement.
2. Click PDF in the export toolbar.
3. Re-run and click Excel.
4. Re-run and click CSV.
expected: Each click triggers a file download: income-statement_<from>_<to>.<ext>. Request carries format=PDF|XLSX|CSV. Button shows exporting state while in flight. A role without REPORT.EXPORT sees no export buttons. Backend /income-statement/export returns 403 for that role.

title: Income Statement forbidden for user without REPORT.PL.VIEW
preconditions: A user with no permissions. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/income-statement.
2. Observe nav item visibility and route access.
expected: The Income Statement nav item is hidden. Direct navigation shows the forbidden permission message. GET /api/v1/reports/income-statement returns 403.

title: Balance Sheet renders asset, liability, equity sections and reconciles
preconditions: Company with a balanced set of books as at 2026-06-30. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.BS.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/balance-sheet.
2. Choose company by name.
3. Set As-at date: 2026-06-30.
4. Click Run.
expected: Sections CURRENT_ASSETS, NON_CURRENT_ASSETS, CURRENT_LIABILITIES, NON_CURRENT_LIABILITIES, EQUITY with subtotals and totals for Total Assets, Total Liabilities, Total Equity. Green Reconciled bar when Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Equity. An all-zero period still balances (ties=true).

title: Balance Sheet data-integrity alarm when reconciliation fails (ties=false)
preconditions: A fixture where Total Assets != Total Liabilities + Total Equity. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps: 1. Run the balance sheet against the broken fixture.
expected: A red alert-danger: 'Data integrity alarm — <label> (difference: <amount>). Investigate the books.' replaces the green reconciled bar. The statement is still shown. Nothing is auto-corrected (read-only — BR-REP-08).

title: Balance Sheet export PDF, XLSX, CSV gated by REPORT.EXPORT
preconditions: Balance sheet run complete. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.EXPORT).
steps:
1. Run the balance sheet.
2. Export as PDF, then XLSX, then CSV.
expected: Each downloads as balance-sheet_<asAt>.<ext>. Request includes asAtDate, optional compareAsAt, and format. Role without REPORT.EXPORT sees no export buttons and API returns 403.

title: Cash-Flow Statement renders OPERATING, INVESTING, FINANCING sections and net change
preconditions: Company with cash movements in H1 2026. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.CASHFLOW.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/cash-flow.
2. Choose company by name.
3. Set from: 2026-01-01, to: 2026-06-30.
4. Click Run.
expected: Sections OPERATING, INVESTING, FINANCING each with line items. Totals for Opening Cash, Net Change in Cash, Closing Cash. Green Reconciled bar when net change matches delta of cash-equivalent GL accounts. Comparative column absent when not provided. No-permission user sees 403/forbidden.

title: Account Ledger drill-down shows opening balance, running lines, closing balance
preconditions: A GL account with at least one posted journal line in Q1 2026. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.LEDGER.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/account-ledger.
2. Choose company by name.
3. In the account picker, select account Bank — Main Current by name.
4. Set from: 2026-01-01, to: 2026-06-30.
5. Click Run.
testData: Account: Bank — Main Current (code 1100). Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30.
expected: Screen shows account code + name header. Opening balance as-at fromDate-1. Running journal lines with running balance column (negatives in danger). Closing balance as-at toDate. Account selected by name via uid-picker — no UID typed or visible on screen.

title: Account Ledger pagination — more than 50 lines shows multiple pages
preconditions: An account with more than 50 journal lines in the period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. Run the ledger for the busy account.
2. Use paginator: NEXT, page numbers, PREVIOUS, FIRST, LAST.
expected: Page 1 shows 50 rows. NEXT loads page 2 (rows 51-100). LAST loads the final page. Each navigation re-fetches. PageMeta reports totalPages=3, hasNext=true on pages 0-1. Paginator self-hides for accounts with 50 or fewer lines.

title: Account Ledger export bounded at 10000 rows — gated by REPORT.EXPORT
preconditions: An account with more than 10000 lines. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has REPORT.EXPORT).
steps:
1. Run the ledger for the long account.
2. Export as PDF, XLSX, CSV.
expected: Each export triggers a download: account-ledger_<code>_<from>_<to>.<ext>. The export pulls a single bounded page of size 10000 (LEDGER_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS). A 10001-line ledger exports only the first 10000 rows. Role without REPORT.EXPORT: no export controls and API returns 403.

title: BI Dashboard loads all panels for a full-permission user
preconditions: Company with finance, cash, AR/AP, inventory, and CRM data. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BI.VIEW + BI.FINANCE.VIEW + BI.OPS.VIEW + BI.CRM.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/dashboard.
2. Wait for company and branch to auto-select and the composite GET /bi/dashboard to resolve.
testData: Company with data across all panel types.
expected: Health strip renders (role=status) with AR/AP/Cash/Stock/TB badges using [OK]/[!] text prefixes. Finance stat-cards, Cash Position, Working Capital, Inventory, CRM pipeline bars and KPIs, Revenue Trend (12 bars), Net Profit Trend all populate. Money formatted to 2 dp. [OK]/[!] text cues present for accessibility.

title: BI Dashboard graceful per-panel forbidden for partial-permission role
preconditions: CUSTOM role with BI.VIEW + BI.FINANCE.VIEW ONLY (lacks BI.OPS.VIEW and BI.CRM.VIEW). Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Log in as the partial-permission user.
2. Navigate to /admin/dashboard.
3. Observe each panel state.
expected: Finance, Working Capital, Cash, and trend panels render normally. Inventory panel shows 'You do not have permission to view inventory KPIs' (per-panel forbidden — NOT whole-page 403). CRM panel shows 'You do not have permission to view CRM KPIs'. Backend returns composite with inventory=null, crm=null.

title: BI Dashboard branch filter re-fetches all panels
preconditions: Company with 2+ branches and branch-scoped CRM and finance data. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open /admin/dashboard.
2. Change Branch in the branch picker (by code — name).
3. Observe panels reload.
4. Change From/To dates and click Refresh.
expected: Changing branch calls loadDashboard(); all panels reset to loading then re-fetch. Composite request includes branchId, from, to. Data updates per branch selection. Branch filter only affects the Sales-by-branch/CRM panel data — the Finance panel shows company-wide data regardless of branch selection. Company with no branches shows '-- no branches --' but dashboard still loads company-wide.

title: BI Dashboard export to PDF, XLSX, CSV gated by BI.EXPORT
preconditions: Dashboard loaded. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BI.EXPORT).
steps:
1. Open the dashboard.
2. Choose format PDF in the export select; click Download.
3. Repeat for Excel and CSV.
expected: File dashboard.<ext> downloads for each format. Request carries companyId, optional branchId/from/to, and format. Export block absent for a role without BI.EXPORT. Backend /dashboard/export returns 403 for that role. Double-click guarded by exporting() signal.

title: BI Dashboard route blocked for user without BI.VIEW
preconditions: No-permission user. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Inspect sidebar — confirm Dashboard nav item is absent.
2. Attempt direct navigation to /admin/dashboard.
expected: Dashboard nav item not shown. Route guard (requirePermission('BI.VIEW')) blocks entry. All panel endpoints return 403 if hit directly. applyGlobalError marks every panel forbidden.

title: Budget Variance report runs for full year showing budget, actual, variance, favourable/adverse labels
preconditions: An APPROVED budget + posted GL actuals for the fiscal year. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.REPORT.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/budgeting/variance.
2. Choose company by name.
3. Enter Fiscal Year UID (free-text field).
4. Leave from=1, to=12; account type = All account types.
5. Click Run.
testData: Fiscal Year UID: <seeded FY uid>. Periods 1-12.
expected: Variance table shows per-account rows: budget, actual, variance (actual - budget), variancePct (null when budget=0), and favourable/adverse label. INCOME: actual > budget = Favourable. EXPENSE: actual < budget = Favourable. ASSET/LIAB/EQUITY = neutral. Totals per account type.

title: Budget Variance report shows noApprovedBudget flag when no approved version exists
preconditions: A fiscal year with actuals but only DRAFT or SUBMITTED budget versions (none APPROVED). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Run the variance report for that fiscal year.
testData: FY with actuals but no APPROVED budget.
expected: header.noApprovedBudget = true. All budget amounts = 0. Variance = actual amounts. UI surfaces the 'no approved budget' condition explicitly. Report is never silently wrong (BR-BUD-12/16).

title: Budget Variance period-range validation — from > to and out-of-range rejected
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Enter from-period = 8, to-period = 3 (from > to); Run.
2. Enter from = 0; Run.
3. Enter to = 13; Run.
expected: Client validation blocks: 'Period range must be 1-12 and from <= to.' No request is sent. Server also rejects (VarianceQuery IllegalArgumentException). Boundary values from=1,to=12 and from=12,to=12 are accepted.

title: Budget Variance filtered by account type EXPENSE shows only expense accounts with correct favourable logic
preconditions: An APPROVED budget with INCOME and EXPENSE accounts. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Run variance with account type = Expense.
expected: Only EXPENSE account rows returned. Favourable label applies the EXPENSE rule: actual < budget = Favourable (negative variance is good). Request sends accountType=EXPENSE. Switching to accountType=INCOME flips the favourable rule (positive variance = Favourable).

title: Dimension-sliced trial balance requires both COSTING.VIEW and GL.VIEW
preconditions: A CUSTOM role with COSTING.VIEW but NOT GL.VIEW. A role with both. Journals tagged with cost-centre values. Logged in as each user.
steps:
1. Log in as role with COSTING.VIEW only; navigate to /admin/cost-centre/report.
2. Log in as role with both; run with slot = Cost Centre.
expected: COSTING.VIEW-only: forbidden state (component sets state=forbidden; API returns 403). Both permissions: sliced TB shows rows grouped by cost-centre dimension value with totalDebit/totalCredit/net. No balanced indicator (a slice does not net to zero by design). Footer shows totals.

title: Reporting cross-tenant isolation — company A user cannot read company B data
preconditions: Two companies A and B. User assigned only to company A with full reporting permissions.
steps:
1. As company-A user, call GET /api/v1/reports/income-statement?companyId=<B>.
2. Repeat for balance-sheet, cash-flow, account-ledger, trial-balance, /bi/dashboard, /budgeting/variance.
testData: Company B companyId, company A user.
expected: Every call denied (403 / scope error). assertCanActIn rejects acting in company B. The UI company picker only lists company-A companies, so the UID for B is never selectable.

title: Asset category list loads with four states (loading, idle, empty, forbidden)
preconditions: Company A has at least one category MACH. A company with no categories. No-permission user exists. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.CATEGORY.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/asset-categories.
2. Observe loading then the populated table (code, name, method, life, status badge).
3. Switch company selector to a company with no categories.
4. Log in as the no-permission user and attempt the route.
expected: Loaded table shows code, name, method, life, status badge. Empty company shows distinct empty state (not error). No-permission user sees nav item hidden and route blocked. API 403 -> forbidden state (distinct from generic error).

title: Create asset category STRAIGHT_LINE method — happy path
preconditions: Company A. GL account IDs known (asset, accum-dep, dep-expense). No category FURN yet. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.CATEGORY.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open /admin/asset-categories; click New Category.
2. Enter Code: FURN, Name: Furniture, Method: Straight Line, Life periods: 60.
3. Enter asset account ID, accumulated-dep account ID, dep-expense account ID.
4. Submit.
testData: code: FURN, name: Furniture, defaultMethod: STRAIGHT_LINE, defaultLifePeriods: 60, GL account IDs.
expected: HTTP 201 CREATED. AssetCategoryDto with status=ACTIVE. Success toast. List refreshes showing Furniture. defaultReducingRate is null for STRAIGHT_LINE. C1 note: account IDs are typed numeric IDs (known gap, not a picker).

title: Create asset category REDUCING_BALANCE requires reducing rate
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.CATEGORY.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open create form; choose method = Reducing Balance.
2. Leave reducing rate blank; submit — expect inline error.
3. Enter reducing rate 0.25; submit.
testData: code: VEH, name: Vehicles, method: REDUCING_BALANCE, reducingRate blank then 0.25.
expected: First submit blocked: 'Reducing rate is required for Reducing Balance method.' Second creates the category with defaultMethod=REDUCING_BALANCE, defaultReducingRate=0.25.

title: Duplicate category code rejected per company (409 Conflict)
preconditions: Category MACH already exists in Company A. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. Create another category with code MACH in the same company.
2. Submit.
testData: code: MACH (already exists in company A).
expected: 409 ConflictException: 'Asset category code MACH already exists in this company.' Message in form error. Same code in a different company succeeds.

title: Archive category soft-deletes it and hides it from the register picker
preconditions: An unused category OLD. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.CATEGORY.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open OLD category detail; click Archive.
2. Return to the category list.
3. Navigate to /admin/fixed-assets/create; open the Category dropdown.
expected: archive() returns DTO with status=ARCHIVED. The row remains in the list (soft-delete) with ARCHIVED badge. OLD is NOT offered in the register create picker (picker filters status=ACTIVE). Code is not editable after creation.

title: Register asset in DRAFT status — STRAIGHT_LINE, branch via picker
preconditions: Company A with ACTIVE category MACH and at least one ACTIVE branch. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.REGISTER.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fixed-assets/create.
2. Select company; pick Category Machinery from dropdown.
3. Choose Branch via app-uid-picker by branch name.
4. Enter name: Lathe #1, acquisitionCost: 5000000, salvageValue: 500000, Method: Straight Line, Life periods: 60, acquisitionDate: 2026-01-15, depreciationStartDate: 2026-02-01.
5. Submit.
testData: name: Lathe #1, acquisitionCost: 5000000, salvageValue: 500000, method: STRAIGHT_LINE, lifePeriods: 60, acquisitionDate: 2026-01-15, depreciationStartDate: 2026-02-01.
expected: HTTP 201. Asset created with status=DRAFT, assetNumber generated. Navigates to /admin/fixed-assets/uid/:uid. No GL posting yet (capitalisation happens at place-in-service). Branch chosen via picker by name — no UID typed. costCentreId field is a typed numeric ID (C1 known gap).

title: Register asset list paginated with status filter and four states
preconditions: Company A with assets in DRAFT, IN_SERVICE, DISPOSED, WRITTEN_OFF statuses. More than 20 assets. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.VIEW).
steps:
1. Open /admin/fixed-assets; observe loading -> idle with 20 rows.
2. Use paginator FIRST/PREV/pages/NEXT/LAST.
3. Set status filter to In Service; verify only IN_SERVICE rows.
4. Set filter to Disposed; verify only DISPOSED rows.
5. Log in as no-permission user; confirm forbidden state.
testData: Assets in all four statuses. 21+ total assets.
expected: List is paginated (size=20) with meta. Status filter sends ?status= query param. Each status filter yields only matching rows. Empty result for a status with no matches shows empty state. No-permission user sees forbidden state (403 -> forbidden, not generic error). Paginator self-hides at 1 page.

title: Edit non-financial fields allowed in DRAFT but rejected in IN_SERVICE (BR-FA-09)
preconditions: One DRAFT asset and one IN_SERVICE asset. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.REGISTER.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT asset detail; edit name to Lathe #1 (rev), location Bay 3, asset tag TAG-001; save.
2. Open the IN_SERVICE asset; attempt the same edit via API.
testData: DRAFT asset: name Lathe #1 (rev), location Bay 3, assetTag TAG-001. IN_SERVICE asset same fields.
expected: DRAFT edit succeeds. IN_SERVICE edit returns: 'Non-financial fields can only be updated while DRAFT (BR-FA-09).' HTTP 400 in envelope errors. Same rejection for DISPOSED and WRITTEN_OFF status.

title: Place DRAFT asset in service — capitalisation GL journal posted, schedule generated
preconditions: A DRAFT asset under category with valid GL accounts. An OPEN fiscal period covering posting date. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.REGISTER.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT asset detail.
2. Click Place in Service.
3. Enter posting date: 2026-02-01.
4. Confirm.
expected: Status flips to IN_SERVICE. capitalisedGlEntryUid populated. A depreciation schedule is generated and visible in the Schedule child table. Success toast with assetNumber. No raw UID shown on screen (assetNumber is the human identifier).

title: Place-in-service rejected when asset is not in DRAFT status
preconditions: Assets in IN_SERVICE, DISPOSED, WRITTEN_OFF. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. POST place-in-service on an IN_SERVICE asset.
2. Repeat for DISPOSED and WRITTEN_OFF.
expected: Each returns: 'Asset must be DRAFT to place in service.' HTTP 400. No status change.

title: Preview depreciation for an open period — read-only, nothing persisted
preconditions: Company A with IN_SERVICE assets having eligible schedule lines for the chosen open fiscal period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.DEPRECIATE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/depreciation-runs/post.
2. Select company; enter the fiscal period UID.
3. Click Preview.
4. Review the preview table (asset number, name, period seq, planned charge) and totals.
expected: DepreciationRunPreviewDto returned. Nothing persisted — no run created, schedule lines untouched. Totals match sum of preview lines. Unknown fiscalPeriodUid -> NotFound(FiscalPeriod). No eligible assets -> empty preview (assetCount 0, total 0).

title: Post depreciation run — creates POSTED run with one GL journal
preconditions: IN_SERVICE assets with eligible schedule lines. Fiscal period OPEN. No prior run for this company+period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.DEPRECIATE).
steps:
1. After previewing, enter posting date.
2. Click Post.
3. Navigate to the run detail.
expected: HTTP 201. DepreciationRunDto with status=POSTED, runNumber, totalChargeAmount, assetCount, glEntryUid, lines[]. Each eligible schedule line marked posted. Each asset's accumulatedDepreciation increased. GL entry posted (append-only). Run number shown, not UID.

title: Duplicate depreciation run for same company+period rejected (D-4)
preconditions: A run already POSTED for company A, period P. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps: 1. Attempt to post depreciation again for the same company and period P.
testData: Same company+period as an existing POSTED run.
expected: 'Depreciation run already posted for company=... period=... (run=...). Duplicate runs are not allowed (ADR-0030 D-4).' HTTP 409. No second run created, no double GL.

title: Revalue asset UP — carrying cost increases and schedule regenerated
preconditions: An IN_SERVICE asset. An OPEN fiscal period for the revaluation date. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.DISPOSE).
steps:
1. Open the asset detail.
2. Click Revalue; choose direction = UP; enter delta: 1000000; date: 2026-03-31; reason: market appraisal.
3. Confirm.
expected: AssetRevaluationDto with direction=UP, carryingAfter = carryingBefore + 1000000. revaluationReserveBalance increased on the asset. Revaluation GL journal posted. Remaining schedule regenerated. Revaluation appears in the Revaluations child table.

title: Revalue DOWN below accumulated depreciation — rejected at the boundary
preconditions: IN_SERVICE asset with known carrying cost and accumulated depreciation. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps: 1. Revalue DOWN by a delta such that carryingAfter < accumulatedDepreciation (via API).
expected: 'Down-revaluation would reduce carrying cost below accumulated depreciation.' HTTP 400. No change. A delta that brings carryingAfter exactly equal to accumulatedDepreciation is allowed (only strictly-below is rejected).

title: Dispose asset by SALE — gain/loss computed and disposal GL posted
preconditions: An IN_SERVICE asset with known NBV. An OPEN fiscal period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.DISPOSE).
steps:
1. Open the asset detail.
2. Click Dispose; enter disposal date: 2026-04-30; proceeds: 3000000; reason: sold to vendor.
3. Confirm.
expected: Final-period depreciation is posted first (any unposted schedule lines up to disposal date charged per BR-FA-10). Then gainLossAmount = proceeds - NBV is computed. AssetDisposalDto with disposalType=SALE, nbvAtDisposal, gainLossAmount. Disposal GL journal posted. Status -> DISPOSED. disposedAt set.

title: Write-off asset — status becomes WRITTEN_OFF, proceeds forced to zero
preconditions: An IN_SERVICE asset. OPEN fiscal period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.DISPOSE).
steps:
1. Open the asset detail.
2. Click Write-off; enter date: 2026-04-30; reason: obsolete.
3. Confirm.
expected: AssetDisposalDto with disposalType=WRITE_OFF, proceedsAmount=0, gainLossAmount = -NBV (full NBV is the loss). Final-period depreciation posted first. Status -> WRITTEN_OFF. Write-off GL journal posted. The write-off form has no proceeds field.

title: Dispose or write-off rejected when asset is not IN_SERVICE (BR-FA-03)
preconditions: A DRAFT asset and an already-DISPOSED asset. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. Attempt dispose on a DRAFT asset via API.
2. Attempt dispose on an already-DISPOSED asset.
expected: DRAFT: 'Only IN_SERVICE assets can be disposed (BR-FA-03).' DISPOSED: 'Asset has already been disposed.' HTTP 409/400. No change. Double-dispose guard checked: exactly one disposal record per asset.

title: FA reconciliation report shows cost and accum-dep ties (green when books match)
preconditions: Company A with IN_SERVICE assets; register and GL tie after posted runs. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (has FA.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/fixed-assets/reconciliation.
2. Select company by name.
testData: Company A with matching FA register and GL.
expected: FixedAssetReconciliationDto returned. costTies and accumDepTies both true. Screen renders matching/ties indicators. Company with no FA activity shows zero bars that tie. A deliberate mismatch makes costTies=false and shows a 'does not tie' state.

title: FA permission matrix — each code gates only its actions
preconditions: CUSTOM roles each granting exactly one of: FA.CATEGORY.VIEW, FA.CATEGORY.MANAGE, FA.VIEW, FA.REGISTER.MANAGE, FA.DISPOSE, FA.DEPRECIATE. A no-permission user. rootadmin.
steps: 1. For each role, attempt each FA endpoint and observe nav visibility and HTTP response.
testData: Six single-permission roles + no-permission user + rootadmin.
expected: FA.CATEGORY.VIEW: list/get categories only. FA.CATEGORY.MANAGE: create/update/archive. FA.VIEW: list/get assets, schedule, revaluations, reconciliation, run list/detail. FA.REGISTER.MANAGE: register, acquire-from-bill, update, place-in-service, transfer. FA.DISPOSE: dispose, write-off, revalue. FA.DEPRECIATE: preview and post runs. No-permission: all 403 and nav hidden. rootadmin: all allowed, all companies.

title: Budget list loads paginated with company selector and four states
preconditions: At least one budget exists for the company. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/budgets.
2. Observe company selector defaults to first company and list loads.
3. Read table rows: budget number, name, fiscal year, latest status badge.
expected: Table renders with rows. latestStatus badge shows APPROVED (preferred), else latest version status. ApiResponse<List<BudgetDto>> with meta. Paginator present (hidden if 1 page). No raw UID in any cell. No-permission user: nav item hidden and route blocked.

title: Filter budget list by version status (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED)
preconditions: Budgets with versions across multiple statuses. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. On /admin/budgets, choose status filter DRAFT.
2. Observe list reloads to page 0 with only matching budgets.
3. Repeat for SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED, and All statuses.
testData: Budgets in all five version statuses.
expected: Each status filter sends versionStatus query param and returns only matching budgets. All statuses clears the filter. A status with no matches shows empty state (not error).

title: Create a company-wide budget — v1 DRAFT auto-created
preconditions: An active fiscal year exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.MANAGE).
steps:
1. On /admin/budgets, click to open the create form.
2. Enter Name: FY2026 Operating Budget.
3. Enter Fiscal Year UID (free-text field — current UI).
4. Submit.
testData: name: FY2026 Operating Budget, fiscalYearUid: <seeded FY uid>.
expected: HTTP 201. Success alert with budgetNumber. List reloads showing new budget with DRAFT v1. Service auto-creates version 1 in DRAFT. No GL posting (D-7). MANAGE required; VIEW-only role sees 403. C1 note: fiscal year is a free-text UID input today (documented gap).

title: Duplicate budget scope rejected — same company+fiscalYear+costCentre
preconditions: A company-wide budget already exists for the fiscal year. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Attempt to create a second company-wide budget for the same fiscal year.
testData: Same company + same FY + null cost centre.
expected: ConflictException: 'A budget already exists for this fiscal year and cost centre scope.' Surfaced as errors[0] in the form. A different cost-centre value for the same FY is allowed.

title: Budget detail shows header and all versions with status badges
preconditions: A budget with 2+ versions in differing statuses. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. From the list, open a budget row.
2. Read the header (number, name) and the versions list ordered version-no desc.
expected: Header + versions render. Each version shows version-no as V{n}, label, status badge, line count. Action buttons appear conditionally by status + permission. UID is only in the URL, not shown as a label.

title: Re-plan: seed a new version from a prior version using picker
preconditions: A budget with an APPROVED v1 containing several lines. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.MANAGE).
steps:
1. On budget detail, open New version form.
2. In the Seed from version picker, choose V1 by its label (e.g. V1 — label, hint = APPROVED).
3. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. New DRAFT version with all lines copied (same accounts, periods, amounts, memos). seededFromVersionId set. Original version unchanged. C1: version chosen via picker by human label — no raw UID typed.

title: Upsert budget lines DIRECT mode — account and period via pickers
preconditions: A DRAFT version. Active GL accounts and 12 fiscal periods exist. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Open the DRAFT version detail; click Edit Lines (Replace All).
2. Mode = DIRECT (default).
3. In Account picker, select account by name (hint = code).
4. In Period picker, select P3 by label.
5. Enter amount: 12000.50; memo: Q1 marketing.
6. Add a second line for a different period.
7. Submit Replace Lines.
testData: Account by name. Period: P3. amount: 12000.50. memo: Q1 marketing.
expected: HTTP 200. Version returned with two lines. Amount stored scale 4 HALF_UP. Table + grand total update. Success alert 'N line(s)'. C1: account and period selected by name/label — no typed UID.

title: Upsert budget lines ANNUAL_SPREAD mode — even spread with remainder on last period
preconditions: DRAFT version with FY having exactly 12 periods. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open Edit Lines; choose mode Annual spread.
2. Pick account via picker.
3. Enter annual amount: 100000.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 200. 12 lines created, one per period. Per-period = 8333.3333 x11, last period absorbs remainder so sum = 100000.0000 exactly (HALF_UP, scale 4, via BudgetSpreadCalculator). Currency is TZS (server constant, not user-settable).

title: Line amount must be 0 or positive — negative amount rejected (BR-BUD-09)
preconditions: A DRAFT version. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. In DIRECT mode, enter amount = -100.
2. Submit.
expected: ConflictException: 'amount must be >= 0 (BR-BUD-09).' HTTP 409/400. No lines saved. Amount = 0 is allowed.

title: Edit lines blocked when version is not DRAFT
preconditions: Versions in SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. For each non-DRAFT version, attempt PUT .../lines via API (UI hides the button).
testData: Non-DRAFT version statuses: SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED.
expected: ConflictException: 'Budget version lines are editable only in DRAFT status; current: <status>.' UI never shows the edit button when not DRAFT. Recalling a SUBMITTED back to DRAFT then allows editing again.

title: Submit DRAFT version to SUBMITTED — requires at least one line (BR-BUD-11)
preconditions: A DRAFT version with at least one line. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.SUBMIT).
steps: 1. On budget detail, click Submit on the DRAFT version.
expected: Status -> SUBMITTED. submittedAt and submittedBy stamped. Success alert. Lines now locked. Submitting a DRAFT with NO lines returns ConflictException: 'must have at least one line before submission (BR-BUD-11).' MANAGE-but-no-SUBMIT role returns 403.

title: Recall SUBMITTED version back to DRAFT
preconditions: A SUBMITTED version. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.SUBMIT).
steps: 1. On budget detail, click Recall on the SUBMITTED version.
expected: Status -> DRAFT. submittedAt and submittedBy cleared (null). Lines editable again. Alert 'recalled to Draft'. Recalling a DRAFT/APPROVED/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED returns: 'Only a SUBMITTED version can be recalled; current: <status>.' Without SUBMIT permission: 403.

title: Approve SUBMITTED version — supersedes prior APPROVED in the same scope
preconditions: V1 APPROVED. V2 SUBMITTED (same company/FY scope). Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.APPROVE).
steps:
1. Click Approve on V2.
2. Optionally enter approve note: Approved by finance committee.
3. Confirm.
expected: V2 -> APPROVED (approvedAt, approvedBy, decisionReason set). V1 -> SUPERSEDED (supersededAt set) in the same transaction. Budget reloads showing both. PESSIMISTIC_WRITE serialises concurrent approvals. SUBMIT-only role returns 403.

title: Reject SUBMITTED version — reason is required
preconditions: A SUBMITTED version. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.BUDGET.APPROVE).
steps:
1. Click Reject on the SUBMITTED version.
2. Leave reason blank — expect client error.
3. Enter reason: Over budget ceiling; revise opex.
4. Confirm.
testData: reason: Over budget ceiling; revise opex.
expected: Blank reason: 'Rejection reason is required' (client) and @NotBlank 400 (server). With reason: status -> REJECTED (rejectedAt, rejectedBy, decisionReason=reason). Terminal state — re-plan via a new version. Without APPROVE permission: 403.

title: Illegal lifecycle transitions — approve/reject/submit from terminal or wrong states
preconditions: Versions in DRAFT, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Attempt to approve a DRAFT version.
2. Attempt to reject a DRAFT version.
3. Attempt to submit an already-SUBMITTED version.
4. Attempt any lifecycle action on APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED.
testData: Versions in each illegal source state.
expected: ConflictException for each: 'Only a SUBMITTED version can be approved/rejected; current: <status>.' and 'Only a DRAFT version can be submitted; current: <status>.' Terminal states (REJECTED, SUPERSEDED) accept no lifecycle action.

title: Lifecycle action buttons gated by status and permission in UI
preconditions: A budget with DRAFT and SUBMITTED versions. CUSTOM roles: VIEW-only, VIEW+MANAGE, VIEW+SUBMIT, VIEW+APPROVE.
steps:
1. For each role, open the budget detail.
2. Observe which action buttons render per version status.
testData: Four CUSTOM roles. One DRAFT and one SUBMITTED version.
expected: Submit/Recall visible only with BUDGETING.BUDGET.SUBMIT. Approve/Reject only with BUDGETING.BUDGET.APPROVE. New version/Edit only with BUDGETING.BUDGET.MANAGE. Buttons shown only for legal transitions (Submit on DRAFT, Recall/Approve/Reject on SUBMITTED). VIEW-only sees no lifecycle buttons.

title: Budget Variance report runs with full year and all account types
preconditions: An APPROVED budget + posted GL actuals for the FY. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.REPORT.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/budgeting/variance.
2. Select company; enter Fiscal Year UID (free-text).
3. From = 1, To = 12, Account type = All.
4. Click Run.
testData: Fiscal Year UID: <seeded FY uid>. Periods 1-12.
expected: Report renders per-account rows: budget, actual, variance (actual - budget), variancePct (null when budget=0). Totals by AccountType. Favourable/adverse label in UI. INCOME: actual > budget = Favourable. EXPENSE: actual < budget = Favourable. ASSET/LIAB/EQUITY = neutral. No-permission: 403/forbidden.

title: Variance report cross-tenant isolation — company A user denied company B data
preconditions: Two companies A and B. User assigned only to company A. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Call GET /api/v1/budgeting/variance?companyId=<B>.
2. Attempt GET /api/v1/budget-versions/uid/{B-version-uid}.
testData: Company B companyId. Company B version UID.
expected: assertCanActIn denies cross-company (403). Resources resolved with mismatched companyId yield NotFound (FY/DimensionValue filtered by company). List never returns Company B rows even without explicit filter.

title: Departmental actuals report shows GL actuals grouped by cost-centre x account
preconditions: Fiscal year with GL postings tagged to cost centres. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (has BUDGETING.REPORT.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/budgeting/departmental-actuals.
2. Select company; enter Fiscal Year UID; from=1, to=12.
3. Click Run.
testData: Fiscal Year UID: <seeded FY uid>. Periods 1-12.
expected: Rows grouped by cost-centre value x account with actualAmount. Null cost-centre = Unallocated bucket. No budget join (actuals only). Missing company or FY UID -> client validation error. No-permission -> 403/forbidden.

title: Departmental actuals four states — empty, error, forbidden
preconditions: A FY with no actuals. A no-permission user. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN for states 1-2, then as no-permission user.
steps:
1. Run for a FY with no postings — empty rows.
2. Intercept the call to return 500 — error state.
3. Log in as no-permission user — 403 — forbidden state.
testData: FY with zero actuals. 500 intercept. No-permission user.
expected: Each state distinct: empty rows (idle-empty), error message (error), forbidden message (forbidden). Loading state shown while request in flight.

title: No GL journal created by any budgeting action (BR-BUD-01 / D-7)
preconditions: A clean GL. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Create a budget.
2. Add lines.
3. Submit.
4. Approve.
5. Inspect GL journals.
expected: ZERO GL journals or entries created by any budgeting action. Budgets are plan-only. GL actuals are read only at report time. No accounting entries ever result from budget create, version create, submit, recall, approve, or reject.
